title: useLayout composable collides with Nuxt built-in
description: Nuxt now auto-imports a built-in useLayout(): ComputedRef<LayoutName>, which shadows app/composables/use-layout.ts. main.vue destructures handlePanelSizeChange from the wrong one → undefined → 'not a function' error thrown by SplitterGroup @layout on any panel resize. Introduced by the Vite+/Nuxt toolchain migration (163d5b9). Fixed by renaming to usePanelLayout.

title: e2e wdio onPrepare still invoked bun after the Vite+ migration
description: `wdio.conf.ts` onPrepare ran `bun run tauri build --debug --no-bundle`, a leftover from before 163d5b9 (Vite+/pnpm migration). bun is not on the CI runner, so the debug binary was never built and every e2e spec failed with an opaque tauri-driver 'failed to execute child process .../target/debug/swim (No such file or directory)'. Switched to `vp run tauri build` and made a non-zero build status throw.
close_reason: Fixed in wdio.conf.ts — vp run tauri build, plus a throw on non-zero status.

title: Migrate to Vite+ (vp), trim ESLint to Vue-only, switch bun→pnpm
description: Adopt vite-plus toolchain: vp for lint/fmt/check/test via oxlint+oxfmt configured in vite.config.ts. Keep ESLint only for what oxlint/oxfmt cannot do (Vue SFC formatting/rules). Then migrate package manager from bun to pnpm. Nuxt+Tauri keep owning dev/build.

title: Now Playing in Control Centre
description: Populate `MPNowPlayingInfoCenter` so the lock screen, Control Centre and menu bar show the current track and artwork. Note: the existing `set_now_playing` command (`lastfm.rs:86`) is the Last.fm scrobbler API, unrelated to this.

title: Media keys
description: F7/F8/F9 and headphone transport buttons do nothing. Needs `MPRemoteCommandCenter` on macOS (and the equivalent elsewhere). Skip/prev commands need the queue to act on.

title: Fetch and embed album art
description: Download cover art for tracks that lack it and embed as APIC. Same capability-scoping caveat as the MusicBrainz lookup.

title: MusicBrainz / Discogs lookup
description: Auto-tag from an online database, matching by acoustic fingerprint or existing tags. Note Tauri HTTP capabilities are currently scoped to Last.fm only — the capability scope needs extending.

title: Rename / move files from tags
description: MusicBee's auto-organise: move and rename files into a folder structure from a tag template. Destructive, so it needs a dry-run preview and must handle collisions and cross-volume moves safely.

title: Tag from filename
description: Parse a filename pattern (e.g. `{track} - {artist} - {title}`) and write the results to tags. Preview before applying.

title: Batch tag editing
description:
Edit tags across many selected tracks at once. `id3.rs:50 write_id3_frames` writes a single file; multi-select already exists (`app/composables/use-track-selection.ts`).

Needs a batch write path with partial-failure reporting and a way to show mixed values across the selection.

title: Recently added / most played views
description: Built-in views over date-added and play-count data.

title: Playlist folders
description: Nest and group playlists. `playlists` table is currently flat; needs a parent reference and a tree UI in the library sidebar.

title: Smart playlists
description: Rule-based auto-updating playlists — the MusicBee signature feature. Needs a rule model (field / operator / value, and/or groups), a query compiler onto the Kysely layer, and an editor UI. Depends on having fields worth filtering on.

title: Missing file detection
description: Tracks whose file has moved or been deleted silently fail on play. Detect and surface them, with a way to relocate or purge.

title: Watch folders / auto-rescan
description: `library_folders.last_scanned` exists but scanning is manual. Needs a filesystem watcher (or periodic rescan) that adds new files, updates changed ones and flags deletions, without blocking the UI on large libraries.

title: Duplicate finder
description: Find duplicate tracks across the library. Needs metadata plus technical fields to compare on (tag match, duration match, file hash). `app/utils/get-hasher.ts` already exists.
notes: Implemented against runtime FileEntry data (tags TIT2/TPE1/TALB, duration) + on-demand file-content xxhash via get-hasher — does NOT require the fo2 schema widening. Pure grouping in app/utils/find-duplicate-tracks.ts (unit-tested), UI at /duplicates with metadata/duration/hash strategies, nav item in library tree.

title: Bitrate / format / sample rate columns
description: Symphonia exposes codec parameters during decode but nothing is persisted. Add columns and populate during the scan.

title: Date added / last played columns
description: Neither is stored. Date added comes from the scanner at insert time; last played from the playback path. Both need schema columns and sortable track-list columns.
close_reason: Added date_added/last_played to library_tracks (migration v10), surfaced via FileEntry in read.rs, with sortable Date added / Last played track-list columns. Implemented independently of the fo2 schema widening.

title: Local play count
description:
Play counts come from Last.fm only (`app/composables/use-play-count.ts`, `lastfm.rs:244 get_lastfm_play_count`), so they are wrong offline and for unscrobbled tracks.

Store a local count and last-played timestamp incremented on playback threshold, and decide how it reconciles with the Last.fm figure.

title: Widen library schema: genre, year, track no., disc, composer, album artist
description:
`library_tracks` (see `app/types/db.ts`) stores only `title`, `artist`, `album`, `path`, `filename`, `id`. Everything MusicBee-like — sorting by year, grouping by album artist, genre filtering — is blocked on this.

Needs: a migration adding the columns, extraction in the scanner (`src-tauri/src/read.rs` `get_tracks_data`, id3 frames already parsed in `id3.rs`), a backfill pass for existing rows, and `bun run db:types` to regenerate.

This is the single biggest unblocker in the library area.

title: Opus and WAV support
description:
`src-tauri/Cargo.toml:42` enables symphonia features mp3, isomp4, aac, flac, ogg, mkv, alac, vorbis. Opus and WAV/PCM are missing.

Add the `opus` and `wav`/`pcm` features and confirm the scanner accepts the extensions.

title: Output device picker
description: No way to choose an audio output device; Kira takes the system default. Needs device enumeration, a settings control, and graceful re-routing when a device disappears (headphones unplugged).
close_reason: Implemented: cpal device enumeration (list_output_devices), SetOutputDevice StreamAction that rebuilds the AudioManager on the requested device while preserving playback state, a 1s watchdog that detects a vanished user-selected device via kira's pop_error() and falls back to system default (kira already auto-recovers to default on disconnect at the stream level; the watchdog just keeps our own custom-device bookkeeping/UI in sync and notifies the frontend), a Settings > Playback tab with a device picker, and persistence via prefs.json (output-device key) read at audio-thread startup. cargo check/clippy/fmt and vp check/lint all pass. Live UI run wasn't possible in this fresh worktree (no bootstrapped dev sqlite db) — filed music-test-vibe-qzw for that gap and music-test-vibe-eh6 to regenerate tauri-bindings.ts via the real specta build once possible.

title: Gapless playback
description:
Live albums and DJ mixes get a gap between tracks. Symphonia already decodes with `enable_gapless: true` in `src-tauri/src/waveform.rs:52`, but the Kira playback path in `audio.rs` does not preload or crossfeed the next track.

Needs next-track preloading and sample-accurate handoff. Depends on the queue for knowing what is next.

title: Repeat all / repeat one
description:
`app/components/layout/panel/player/controls.vue:34` renders a repeat icon with no handler. The only looping that exists is `StreamAction::SetLoop(bool)` -> `audio.rs:88 set_loop`, which loops the single current track.

Needs a three-state control: off / repeat-all (wrap the queue) / repeat-one (existing behaviour).

title: Shuffle button is a stub
description:
`app/components/layout/panel/player/controls.vue:12` renders a shuffle icon with no handler.

Needs queue-order shuffling (MusicBee reshuffles the upcoming queue rather than picking randomly each time) plus persistence of the shuffle state.

title: Next / previous track buttons do nothing
description:
`app/components/layout/panel/player/controls.vue:16` and `:30` render skip-back and skip-forward buttons with no `@click` handler. They look functional but are inert.

Wire them to the play queue once it exists.
close_reason: Wired skip-back/forward to a new skipTrack() driven by the track list the current track was played from; buttons are disabled when there is no neighbour. Frontend stopgap — music-test-vibe-vw3 (real queue) should supersede it. Follow-ups: music-test-vibe-u98, music-test-vibe-xq5.

title: Play queue / up next
description:
There is no queue. `StreamAction::Play(String)` in `src-tauri/src/audio.rs` plays a single path, so the engine has no concept of what comes next.

Needs: an ordered queue in Rust, commands to enqueue/dequeue/reorder/jump, auto-advance on track end (see `app/composables/use-playback.ts:78` where playback currently just stops), and a queue panel in the UI.

Blocks next/prev, shuffle, repeat-all, auto-DJ and the macOS transport integrations.
notes: Frontend stopgap landed for next/prev (music-test-vibe-8gy): usePlayback holds `_playbackList` (snapshot of the track list a track was played from) + `skipTrack(offset)`. Replace both with the real queue when this lands.

title: copy-button.vue imports motion-v, which is not a dependency
description: app/components/u/copy-button.vue does 'import { motion } from "motion-v"' but motion-v is in neither package.json nor the old bun.lock, so it has never been installed. The build only survives because the component is unused and Nuxt never bundles it — the moment anything renders <UCopyButton> the build fails to resolve the module. Either add motion-v as a dependency or delete the component. Found by a pnpm-strictness sweep during the Vite+ migration.
acceptance_criteria: Either motion-v is a declared dependency, or copy-button.vue is gone.

title: No vitest test files exist, so the test gate always fails
description: vitest.config.ts declares 'unit' (test/unit/*) and 'nuxt' (test/nuxt/*) projects but neither directory exists, so 'vp test' exits 1 with 'No test files found'. test/setup/nuxt.tauri.ts (Tauri IPC mocks) and test/fixtures/*.mp3 are in place and ready to use. Either add the first tests or set passWithNoTests. Pre-existing, not caused by the Vite+ migration.

title: Unpin vue 3.5.30 once compiler-sfc resolves reka-ui extends types
description: vue is pinned to an exact 3.5.30 in package.json and forced via the pnpm-workspace.yaml override. On 3.5.40, @vue/compiler-sfc fails with 'Failed to resolve extends base type' for reka-ui interfaces of the shape 'interface XProps extends Omit<YProps, ...> {}' (context-menu-content, alert-dialog-content and 5 more) and the Nuxt build dies. Reproduced against both reka-ui 2.9.2 and 2.10.1, so the trigger is vue, not reka-ui. Retest with a newer vue: bump the dependency and the override together, then run 'vp run generate'. The override must also stay until it is proven that a single vue copy is installed — two copies split pinia into two peer identities and silently break @tauri-store/pinia's 'declare module' augmentation.
acceptance_criteria: vp run generate passes with vue unpinned, and 'vp why vue' shows a single version.

title: bun run lint is broken: eslint 10 vs eslint-plugin-vue
description: `bun run lint` fails at rule-load time: "Error while loading rule 'vue/max-attributes-per-line': Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getTemplateBodyTokenStore')" — eslint 10.0.3 resolved via @antfu/eslint-config is incompatible with the installed eslint-plugin-vue. Also lints .beads/README.md, which should be ignored. This blocks the documented quality gate (`bun run lint && bun run test`).
close_reason: Fixed by the Vite+ migration: @antfu/eslint-config is gone, vue/max-attributes-per-line is now fmt.singleAttributePerLine in vite.config.ts, and ESLint is scoped to **/*.vue so .beads/README.md is no longer linted. Gate is now: vp check && vp run lint.

title: Track change notifications
description: `@tauri-apps/plugin-notification` is already a dependency; surface a notification on track change, behind a setting.

title: Import Apple Music library
description: Parse the Apple Music / iTunes library XML to bring across folders, playlists, play counts and ratings. Likely the single biggest thing standing between this app and daily use.

title: ReplayGain scanning
description: Compute track and album gain and write the tags. Feeds the volume normalisation issue.

title: Format conversion
description: Transcode to mp3/opus, with a queue and progress. Needs an encoder — symphonia is decode-only.

title: Lyrics
description: Read embedded lyrics (USLT/SYLT) and optionally fetch missing ones. Synced lyrics would need a display surface.

title: Drag tracks into the queue
description: Drag-and-drop plumbing already exists (`app/composables/use-drag.ts`, `use-draggable.ts`, `@crabnebula/tauri-plugin-drag`); needs the queue as a drop target.

title: Auto-DJ
description: Keep the queue topped up automatically once it runs dry, seeded from the current track or a playlist.

title: Multiple libraries
description: Separate collections the user switches between. Affects the DB layout and every library query — worth a design note before implementation.

title: DSP effects
description: Compressor, stereo width and similar. Builds on the same Kira effect-chain plumbing as the equalizer.

title: Equalizer
description: MusicBee ships a 10-band EQ with presets. Kira supports effect chains on a track/mixer bus. Needs the DSP chain, a preset store, and UI.

title: Resume where you left off on launch
description: Restore the current track, queue and seek position across restarts. Playback state is in `app/composables/use-playback.ts`; persistence already available via `@tauri-store/pinia`.

title: Fresh worktrees can't run 'vp run dev' without manual DB bootstrap
description: 'vp run dev' runs beforeDevCommand -> 'vp run db:types' -> kysely-codegen, which requires DATABASE_URL to point at an existing sqlite db with all diesel/tauri-plugin-sql migrations already applied. A fresh clone/worktree has no such db and no .env, so dev fails immediately with 'Environment variable DATABASE_URL could not be found' (or, once .env is added, kysely-codegen still fails against an empty/missing db). Discovered while implementing music-test-vibe-8zq (output device picker), which blocked live UI verification. Consider a bootstrap script/doc that creates a fresh dev db by applying the migrations from src-tauri/src/lib.rs (or running the app once headlessly) before db:types runs.

title: Regenerate tauri-bindings.ts via specta for output device commands
description: app/types/tauri-bindings.ts additions for list_output_devices/AudioDeviceInfo/SetOutputDevice (added in music-test-vibe-8zq) were hand-written to match tauri-specta's format because a fresh worktree can't run 'vp run dev' (see linked env-bootstrap issue). Run the real dev build once possible and diff the regenerated file against the hand-written version to confirm they match exactly.

title: Previous button should restart current track when past ~3s
description: Standard transport convention (MusicBee, iTunes, Spotify): pressing previous restarts the current track if position > ~3s, and only skips to the previous track when pressed early or twice. `skipTrack(-1)` in `app/composables/use-playback.ts` always skips.

title: Playback list is not persisted across restarts
description: `_playbackList` in `app/composables/use-playback.ts` is in-memory only, so after an app restart the current track is restored from prefs but next/previous stay disabled until the user plays a track from a list again. Persist the source list (or its input key + index) alongside 'current-track'. Likely obsoleted by music-test-vibe-vw3.

title: Root tsconfig.json shape blocks type-aware lint on nuxt.config.ts and test/e2e
description: tsconfig.json uses 'files': ['./**/*.ts'] — 'files' does not accept globs, only 'include' does — alongside 'composite' and project references into .nuxt. tsgolint (behind 'vp check') therefore cannot type nuxt.config.ts (TS2349 on defineNuxtConfig) or test/e2e (missing mocha globals from wdio), and knip.ts references a 'knip' package that is not a dependency at all. Those three paths are currently in lint.ignorePatterns in vite.config.ts as a workaround. Fix the tsconfig (Nuxt's recommended root is 'files': [] plus references), decide whether knip is actually wanted, then drop the ignores.

title: vp staged is not wired: beads owns core.hooksPath
description: vp migrate wrote .vite-hooks/pre-commit ('vp staged') and package.json 'prepare': 'vp config', but hook installation is skipped because core.hooksPath already points at .beads/hooks. The staged block in vite.config.ts ('vp check --fix' for everything, 'eslint --fix' for *.vue) therefore never runs on commit. Fix by appending a 'vp staged' call to .beads/hooks/pre-commit outside the BEGIN/END BEADS INTEGRATION markers, which is the user-owned region.

title: vp fmt cannot load vite.config.ts when an ancestor dir has an old oxfmt
description: In .claude/worktrees/* checkouts, 'vp fmt' and the format step of 'vp check' fail with 'Failed to load configuration file / expected value at line 1 column 1' whenever vite.config.ts contains an 'fmt' block. Cause: vp resolves the oxfmt binary by walking up node_modules, escaping the worktree and finding the parent checkout's bun-installed oxfmt@0.35.0 (pulled in by eslint-plugin-format). 0.35 predates reading the fmt block out of vite.config.ts. Proof: moving /Users/jamie/i/music-test-vibe/node_modules/oxfmt aside makes vp fmt work; a byte-identical project outside that tree always works. Resolves itself once main is on pnpm and eslint-plugin-format is gone, since nothing will hoist oxfmt to the parent node_modules. Worth reporting upstream: vp should prefer its own bundled oxfmt over an ancestor node_modules copy.

title: Last.fm loved tracks sync
description: Pull loved tracks from Last.fm and expose them as a view; optionally push loves back. Last.fm auth already exists in `lastfm.rs`.

title: Mini player / compact mode
description: Small always-on-top window with transport controls and current track.

title: M3U / PLS import and export
description: `@iptv/playlist` is already a dependency. Wire up import into playlists and export back out.

title: Column browser
description: MusicBee's multi-pane filter: pick a genre, then an artist, then an album, each pane narrowing the next. Needs the widened schema to filter on.

title: Artist view
description: Artist page listing their albums and tracks. Needs album artist from the schema work.

title: Star ratings
description: 0-5 stars, a MusicBee core concept and the main input to smart playlists. Store in the DB and optionally write the POPM id3 frame.

title: Album grid view
description: Cover-art wall as an alternative to the track list. Cover art loading already exists (`cover_protocol.rs`, `app/components/cover-art.vue`).

title: Sleep timer
description: Stop playback after a set duration or at the end of the current track.

title: Playback speed / pitch control
description: Adjustable rate, optionally with pitch preservation.

title: Crossfade between tracks
description: Configurable fade duration on track change. Distinct from gapless: this overlaps tracks deliberately.

title: ReplayGain / volume normalisation
description: Apply ReplayGain tags (or computed values) as playback gain so albums do not jump in loudness. Needs the scanning issue to produce values for untagged files.
